description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2001/29 of 11.01.2017, Moratuwa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and amendments to land title particulars such as servitude rights, access rights, and extent measurements. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
